title: navgrid.json
description: data/worlds/<id>/navgrid.json (envgen common.navgrid_dict, compact JSON). Row-major, index = row * width + col, row = z index (row 0 = min z), col = x index (col 0 = min x). Cell (col,row) covers [origin.x + col*cell_m, +cell_m) x [origin.z + row*cell_m, +cell_m). Read width/height/cell_m/origin; never assume 200x200 @ 2 m. Road corridors (max(width_m,10)/2 around each centreline) and 12 m pads around sites / load / dump points / slots are carved to cost 1.0 (common.carve_road_corridors). Consumers: brain planner (planning/navmap.py, WORLD_DIR), envgen checks. len(heights) == len(cost) == width*height is checked by validate.py (not expressible in JSON Schema).

cell_m.description: Cell edge in metres (procedural 2.0; quarry 2.5; marble = extent/220, >= 0.5).

origin.description: World [x, z] of cell (0,0)'s min corner.

heights.description: Ground height y in metres per cell.

cost.description: Traversal cost per cell: 1.0 = flat road, > 1 harder (slope), -1 = impassable.
